# **SSRF with blacklist-based input filter**

Task: This lab has a stock check feature which fetches data from an internal system.

To solve the lab, change the stock check URL to access the admin interface at `http://localhost/admin` and delete the user `carlos`.

The developer has deployed two weak anti-SSRF defenses that you will need to bypass.

Solution

to bypass two weak anti-SSRF defenses you need decimal encoding of 127.0.0.1 which is 127.1 and double URL encoding of any characters in “admin” (one,two,three letters or whole word)

so you do   
StockApi=[http://127.1/a%25%36%34%25%36%64in/delete?username=carlos](http://127.1/a%25%36%34%25%36%64in/delete?username=carlos)

solved
